title: os validate: a wrong dashboard widget filter reads Expected record but received object, with no fix
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

From a real-user walkthrough of the development flow, filed on the maintainer's word: 「第一组：会卡住人或误导人，立卡」 (2026-11-04). Measured on `main` `987ff33b88` unless a line says otherwise. Test project scaffolded with `create-objectstack@18.3.0`.

## What a developer sees

Copying the filter shape from a view, which is natural, into a dashboard widget gives an error that contradicts itself and says nothing about what to write. Almost every other `os validate` refusal in this walkthrough named the fix.

## Measured

A widget with `filter: [{ field: 'status', operator: 'in', value: ['new', 'in_progress'] }]`, the shape a view's filter takes:

```text
✗ defineStack validation failed (2 issues):
✗ dashboards.0.widgets.0.filter: Expected record but received object.
✗ dashboards.0.widgets.0.filter: Expected object but received object.
```

The same array is valid on a view (`src/views/ticket.view.ts`), and the widget wants `{ status: { $in: […] } }`. An AI author hits this directly, because it writes both in one project.

## Expected

The refusal says a widget filter is the object form and shows it, in the corrective style of the other rules. Whether the two surfaces should take one shape is a separate question and is not part of this card.
